d.subject: Final handoff: rejected precise callback can arm accepted synthetic endpoint
d.finding: WallpaperAngleFeed schedules endpoint synthesis from a raw current-poll callback even when Fold7AngleAuthority rejects that real precise sample. Because feedExternal returns no acceptance token and offerSyntheticEndpoint only checks session plus the pre-existing precise lease, a rejected stale-source callback can causally produce accepted synthetic 0/180 geometry.

deterministicWitness.result: synthetic accepted with 42ms of old lease remaining

d.recommendedInvariant: Synthetic endpoint output requires an accepted causal precise-sample token/sequence that is still the current accepted precise authority at bridge fire time.

en: Final R&D handoff: Alpha3 can let a real Samsung precise callback be rejected for stale source age yet still use that raw callback to schedule a synthetic 0/180 endpoint. A source-faithful timing witness shows the synthetic endpoint is accepted 140 ms later under the previous valid precise lease. Bind synthetic endpoints to an accepted causal precise-sample token/sequence. Physical Fold7 occurrence is not claimed; no production GitHub writes were made.
